condition: On a 1-row DataFrame, df.loc[:, col] = a NumPy-backed Series/array into a PyArrow-backed column raises TypeError "Invalid value" because the length-1 array is unwrapped to a 0-d ndarray that pa.scalar can't convert.
workaround: Assign values that already have the Arrow dtype (e.g. keep the RHS as the pyarrow dtype instead of astype(float)), or assign the column directly with df["A"] = ... instead of loc[:, "A"].
